card.text: Explore Hertha in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Nonconvex ADAM shape constrained by resolved AO imaging, light curves and occultations. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 1799 shape model
shape.summary: Nonconvex ADAM shape constrained by resolved AO imaging, light curves and occultations, 79 ± 2 km volume-equivalent diameter. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 1799 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 39.5 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
